claims.evidence: All SILAC experiments are in HeLa cells (paper Results/Methods); MaxQuant searched HUMAN.fasta (parameters.txt).
HeLa derives from cervix (Cellosaurus CVCL_0030); UBERON:0000002 uterine cervix verified.
Cellosaurus cell type epithelial; CL:0000066 verified.
Cellosaurus: human papillomavirus-related cervical adenocarcinoma; no MONDO term for the HPV-related label, parent MONDO:0005153 cervical adenocarcinoma used.
HeLa donor (Henrietta Lacks) was African American; HANCESTRO:0568 verified. Cell-line donor property, not stated in paper.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0030 age at sampling 30Y6M.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0030 sex female.
Donor 30Y6M -> adult (EFO:0001272); inferred from donor age.
Paper: 'SILAC HeLa cells'; EFO:0001185 HeLa. Sub-line/vendor not stated, parental HeLa assumed.
Parental HeLa; paper does not name a sub-line (HeLa-Kyoto was used only for GFP-BAC lines, not MS).
Cellosaurus name for CVCL_0030.
Methods: 'SILAC HeLa cells were grown in SILAC D-MEM (Invitrogen) supplemented with 10% dialyzed FBS'; NCIT:C185409 verified.

Each SILAC channel of each run is a separately cultured/treated sample (Results; SI Fig 4a: six separate time-course experiments; two olaparib experiments; one occupancy experiment). Spec README: numbering restarts per factor-value group (compound|dose|sampling time|treatment). Group 'H2O2 0 minute, no compound' = rows 5,6,7,9,11,13,15 -> 1-7. Group 'H2O2 10 minute, no compound' = rows 2,4,10,18 -> 1-4. Every other group has one sample -> 1. Numbered in row order (review round 2 fix).

Methods 'Enrichment of ADP-ribosylated peptides': peptides were incubated with the Af1521 macro domain and modified peptides eluted. Generic EFO:0009106 'sample enrichment' (child of EFO:0009090, verified live in OLS4, not obsolete) is used because no ADP-ribose-specific enrichment term exists. Rows 17-18 (occupancy run): whether this run was Af1521-enriched or an unenriched lysate is not stated -> not available.

MaxQuant 2-plex (only 'Ratio H/L' columns; Labeling State 0/1). Heavy state carries +8.014 Da per K and +10.008 Da per R in every SILAC run (msms mass deltas), i.e. Lys8/Arg10 = SI Fig 4a 'Heavy (K8, R10)'. No medium channel deposited although the paper lists a K4/R6 medium medium.

Time course: light ~0 min and heavy 0-120 min 500 uM H2O2 (Results; SI Fig 4a). Olaparib exps: 'both light and heavy SILAC cells were treated with H2O2' (Results). Occupancy heavy: 'treated' = H2O2 10 min (SI Fig 4d/e). Written as the NCIT label; NCIT:C28156 Hydrogen Peroxide verified.

SI Fig 4e legend: heavy and light SILAC conditions 'correspond to treated and untreated conditions, respectively' for the occupancy experiment. 'untreated' is the template's own recommended control value (validator warning only).

Time of H2O2 exposure before harvest. SI Fig 4a table: experiments 1-6, light 0 min vs heavy 0,5,10,30,60,120 min. Matched to runs by file names (_0_min,_5_min,_10_min,_30_min,_1_h,_2_h) and MaxQuant experiments H2O2_0min..H2O2_120min. Light '0 minute' = 'stimulated only a few seconds (~0 min)'.

Time of H2O2 exposure before harvest. Row 18: SI Fig 4d/e 'cells exposed to H2O2 for 10 minutes'. Rows 1-4 (olaparib experiments): H2O2 time not stated for these experiments; taken from Methods 'Sample preparation': 'Cells were stimulated with H2O2 for 10 min' (general protocol) - INFERRED. Row 17 (untreated) = not applicable.

This column pairs with characteristics[compound]/[dose] (clinical-metadata drug exposure). Rows 1,3 (olaparib): the paper says only that olaparib 'was introduced before oxidative stress', so its pre-incubation time is not available. All other rows have no compound, so not applicable. No row asserts an olaparib duration.
Results: 'only light SILAC cells were treated with olaparib (1 uM or 10 uM)'; run names Ola_1uM/Ola_10uM; CHEBI:83766 verified.
Olaparib concentration per run: file names HeLaSILAC_Ola_1uM / _Ola_10uM, MaxQuant experiments Ola_1uM / Ola_10uM, Results '(1 uM or 10 uM)'.

claims.location: factor value[treatment] / factor value[sampling time] / factor value[compound] / factor value[dose] rows 1-18
claims.evidence: Compared variables: H2O2 exposure time (time course; sampling time), olaparib +/- and dose, H2O2 vs untreated (occupancy).
Raw headers of all 8 runs read 'Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS'; paper Methods also 'Q Exactive Plus'. PRIDE 'Q Exactive' overridden by raw data.
Raw header of 20150119_..._occupancy.raw reads 'Method of Q Exactive HF' / 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS'.
File names exactly as in PRIDE files/all; 18 rows = 9 runs x 2 channels.
Methods: 'operated using data-dependent acquisition'.
Methods: 'fragmentation ... using HCD'; MS:1000422 (beam-type CID = HCD).

The column records the digestion enzyme (TERMS.tsv: 'Enzyme or chemical used for protein digestion'). Methods: 'Proteins were digested using endoproteinase Lys-C (1:100 w/w) and modified sequencing grade trypsin (1:100 w/w)'. Trypsin is written here. Lys-C was also used in the digestion but has no column: comment[cleavage agent details] is single-cardinality in ms-proteomics v1.2.0, so sdrf-tools build emits one column (see limitations). Search-rule note: MaxQuant 1.3 parameters.txt has no enzyme row and no mqpar.xml was deposited. In msms.txt all 2789 sampled PSMs with an internal K-P/R-P bond have Missed cleavages that do not count that bond, so the search used MaxQuant 'Trypsin' (no cleavage before P), not Trypsin/P (evidence/enzyme_rule_check.txt); the Methods say 'strict trypsin specificity'.
Methods: 'maximum 7 p.p.m. for peptide masses' (parameters.txt of MaxQuant 1.3 does not list it).
parameters.txt 'MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm'; Methods '20 p.p.m. for HCD fragment ion masses'.
parameters.txt 'Fixed modifications Carbamidomethyl (C)'; chloroacetamide alkylation in Methods.

claims.evidence: comment[sdrf version] = SDRF-Proteomics specification version: spec README.adoc line 27 'Version v1.1.0' (also upstream HEAD; coordinator decision). comment[sdrf template] keeps ms-proteomics VV=v1.2.0 per bigbio/sdrf-templates HEAD 7da1747 templates.yaml line 150 'latest: 1.2.0'. Annotation done by manual curation.
Results (method overview): 'As no pre-fractionation steps are employed' (single-shot runs); one injection per run, both channels of a run share technical replicate 1.

limitations: Lys-C (MS:1001309) was used in the digestion (Methods) but has no column: comment[cleavage agent details] is single-cardinality in ms-proteomics v1.2.0, so sdrf-tools build emits only the first value. The SDRF was not hand-edited to add a second column. Rebuilding with Lys-C needs a build/contract change or a coordinator decision to override the template cardinality.
techsdrf not installed: instrument verified by HTTP range-read of .raw headers only; tolerances/acquisition not re-derived from spectra.

Deposited mqpar.xml absent (MaxQuant 1.3.0.5 parameters.txt only): variable modifications taken from modificationSpecificPeptides.txt/msms.txt, SILAC label masses derived from msms.txt mass deltas; precursor tolerance (7 ppm) from paper prose.

Olaparib experiments (rows 1-4): the H2O2 time (sampling time 10 minute) is inferred from the general Methods sample-preparation sentence. Olaparib pre-incubation time is not stated (exposure duration = not available on rows 1,3). H2O2 concentration in these runs is not stated.
H2O2 concentration (500 uM, stated for the time course and benchmark) is not encoded: characteristics[dose] is single-valued and is used for olaparib dose.

Occupancy run (rows 17-18): channel map from SI Fig 4e legend (heavy=treated with H2O2 10 min, light=untreated); the link of this run to that experiment rests on the file name 'H2O2_occupancy' / MaxQuant experiment 'H2O2_occupancy'. Whether this run is Af1521-enriched or an unenriched lysate is not stated.
HeLa sub-line/vendor not stated; parental HeLa CVCL_0030 used.

Af1521 ADP-ribose peptide enrichment is encoded only with the generic EFO:0009106 'sample enrichment'; no ADP-ribose-specific child of EFO:0009090 exists. The occupancy run's enrichment status is not available.
Paper lists a medium SILAC medium (Lys4/Arg6) but none of the deposited runs uses a medium channel (MaxQuant outputs H/L only).

Scope: 15 deposited .raw. This SDRF (PXD004245-hela-silac.sdrf.tsv) covers the 9 SILAC runs. The 3 label-free HeLa runs (PAR_PD_Rep1-3) and 3 mouse liver runs are in companion SDRFs (PXD004245-hela-lfq.sdrf.tsv, PXD004245-liver.sdrf.tsv) because parse_sdrf convert-openms refuses SILAC mixed with label-free, and the mouse rows cannot carry characteristics[cell line] (no reserved word allowed) nor the human template.

PAR_PD deposited names do not match the MaxQuant experiment labels one-to-one: raw headers show Rep1=2xSep-pak (MQ Rep1), Rep2=normal (MQ Rep3), Rep3=Filter (MQ Rep2). Affects only the companion LFQ SDRF.
8 runs named in the MaxQuant design (noCL, 4x H2O2 input, 2x SILAC input, TNKSi) are not deposited in PRIDE and are not annotated.
Mouse liver companion: no deposited mouse search; modifications/tolerances from the paper's general Methods; mouse age (9 weeks) has no licensed column under vertebrates.
Europe PMC fullTextXML returned HTTP 500 and supplementaryFiles failed; paper retrieved through NCBI efetch (numeric id, title verified) and SI from the publisher.
